title: adapters/<name>/adapter.yaml: a runtime adapter, discovered by folder (protocol bay/adapter.py)

name.description: the runtime name; equals the folder name

module.description: the adapter's module, a path inside the adapter folder

class.description: the class in `module` implementing the Adapter protocol

profile.description: The agent profile: how this LLM product runs roles. The only place that knows the product: the runtime per kind of role, the model for each tier, effort values and tool names. Selected once in agentbay.config.yaml (`agent:`, default claude-code).

runtime.description: Runtime per kind of role. coordinator: a mode's coordinator role (claude-code-main runs it as a playbook in the Chief of Staff's main thread); worker: every other role (claude-code-subagent: a generated .claude/agents/<role>--<mode>.md).

tiers.description: The product's model for each tier.

effort.description: The product's value for each effort (default: the same word).

tools.description: Optional: agentbay tool name (as bound in envs) -> the product's tool name (default: the same name).
